identity.name: The Modern Atelier
identity.description: A digital storefront that feels like a Savile Row studio. Clean lines, generous whitespace, tactile textures, and a focus on the human craft of tailoring.

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode default for 'Studio' feel. Dark mode uses Deep Navy (#0f172a) instead of black for richness.
colors.gradients: No gradients. Use solid colors or subtle texture overlays.

buttons.primary: rounded-sm bg-[#1a1a1a] text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] hover:bg-[#c5a059] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: rounded-sm border border-[#1a1a1a] text-[#1a1a1a] px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] hover:bg-[#1a1a1a] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300
buttons.outline: rounded-sm border border-white/20 text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] hover:bg-white hover:text-[#1a1a1a] transition-colors duration-300 backdrop-blur-sm

cards.service: group relative overflow-hidden bg-white border border-stone-100 p-8 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-500
cards.feature: flex flex-col gap-4 p-6 border-l-2 border-[#c5a059]/30 hover:border-[#c5a059] transition-colors bg-stone-50/50

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-stone-300 px-0 py-3 focus:border-[#c5a059] focus:ring-0 rounded-none transition-colors placeholder:text-stone-400 font-sans

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-100/50 transition-all duration-300
navigation.link: text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-widest hover:text-[#c5a059] transition-colors

hero.alt: Master tailor hanging a bespoke jacket

visual_enhancers.overlays: bg-black/20 for image readability. Use 'mix-blend-overlay' for text on textured backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-stone-200 for structure. No heavy borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for subtle depth. shadow-2xl for floating elements (modals).

required_sections: Hero (Full height, Split layout or Background Image)
Services (Grid of cards: Bespoke, Alterations, Wedding)

general: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts without purpose.
Dark colors must be solid, NO gradients.
Use glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-md or xl.
NO universal 'transition: all'. Target specific properties.
NO 'text-align: center' on the main App container.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios (WCAG AA). Use aria-labels on icon buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end Tailor Shop website. Use the provided JSON to guide your styling. Focus on the 'Quiet Luxury' aesthetic—lots of whitespace, elegant serif fonts, and high-quality images. The 'Upload Design' and 'Appointment' features are critical functional requirements. Use shadcn/ui components but style them to match the 'Artisan' theme (square corners, serif fonts in headers). Implement the 'Before & After' slider using a custom component or library if available, ensuring it is touch-friendly.
